704.description: The user sets a shell trap. If the user is hit by a physical move, the trap will explode and inflict damage on opposing Pokémon.
704.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the user was not yet hit by an opponent’s physical move this turn, this move will fail.

705.description: The user unleashes a strong beam. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.
705.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

706.description: The user attacks by biting the target with its psychic capabilities. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.
706.effect: Destroys any Light Screen or Reflect on the target’s side of the field, then inflicts regular damage.

707.description: Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.
707.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Power is doubled if the user’s last move failed for any reason (i.e., produced the message "But it failed!") or was ineffective due to types.

708.description: The user attacks by beating the target with a bone that contains a spirit. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.
708.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

709.description: The user smashes into the target at high speed. This move always goes first.

710.description: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
710.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

711.description: The user shoots powerful lasers using the power of a prism. The user can't move on the next turn.
711.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

712.description: The user hides in the target’s shadow, steals the target’s stat boosts, and then attacks.
712.effect: Steals the target’s stat increases, then inflicts regular damage. Will not steal stat increases that would put any of the user’s stats at more than +6; any excess is left on the target. Stolen increases are affected by abilities as normal.

713.description: The user slams into the target with the force of a meteor. This move can be used on the target regardless of its Ability.
713.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Other Pokémon’s abilities cannot activate in response to this move. In particular, it hits through Disguise

714.description: The user emits a sinister ray to attack the target. This move can be used on the target regardless of its Ability.
714.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Other Pokémon’s abilities cannot activate in response to this move. In particular, it hits through Disguise

715.description: The user gets teary-eyed to make the target lose its combative spirit. This lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats.
715.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage each.

716.description: The user crashes into the target, delivering a powerful electric shock. This may also make the target flinch.
716.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

717.description: The user hits the target with the force of nature. It halves the target’s HP.
717.effect: Inflicts typeless damage equal to half the target’s remaining HP.

718.description: Cloaking itself in high energy, the user slams into the target. The memory held determines the move’s type.
718.effect:
Inflicts regular damage. If the user is holding a plate or a drive, this move’s type is the type corresponding to that item.

Note: This effect is technically shared by both Techno Blast and Judgment; however, Techno Blast is only affected by drives, and Judgment is only affected by plates.

720.description: The user attacks everything around it by causing its own head to explode. This also damages the user.
720.effect: Inflicts damage, and the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP, rounded up. The user still takes damage if the move is blocked by Protect or Substitute, misses, or if the target has Flash Fire.

721.description: The user attacks with electrically charged fists. This move changes Normal-type moves to Electric-type moves.
721.effect: After inflicting damage, all Normal-type moves become Electric-type for the remainder of the turn, including status moves. This effect is applied after move type-changing abilities, such as Pixilate and Normalize.

722.description: The user attacks the target with a pillar of light. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

729.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

742.description: The user rotates, centering the hex nut in its chest, and then strikes with its arms twice in a row. This may also make the target flinch.
742.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in one turn.

744.description: The user condenses energy within its body and unleashes that energy from its core to inflict damage.
744.effect: This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.

745.description: The user ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's moves and Abilities that draw in moves, allowing this move to hit the chosen target.
745.effect: The user ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's moves and Abilities that draw in moves, allowing this move to hit the chosen target.

746.description: This move prevents the user and the target from switching out until either of them faints. The effect goes away if either of the Pokémon leaves the field.
746.effect: Inflicts damage, then prevents you and the target from switching out. The user or target may switch out using a Shed shell, Baton Pass, Flip turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-Turn, or Volt Switch. If they do, the effect ends.

747.description: The user eats its held Berry, then sharply boosts its Defense stat.
747.effect: This move cannot be used unless the user is holding a berry. The user consumes a berry, activates its effects, and raises its defense by 2 stages. This effect works even if Embargo or Magic Room are in effect.

748.description: This move boosts all the user's stats but prevents the user from switching out or fleeing.
748.effect: Prevents user from switching out. Raises all of the user’s stats by one stage. The user or target may switch out using, Baton Pass, Flip turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-Turn, or Volt Switch. Fails if the user already has prevented itself from switching by this effect.

749.description: The user pours sticky tar over the target, lowering the target's Speed stat. The target becomes weaker to Fire-type moves.
749.effect: Lowers the target's Speed by 1 stage. Until the target switches out, the effectiveness of Fire-type moves is doubled against it.

750.description: The user scatters a cloud of magic powder that changes the target's type to Psychic.
750.effect: Causes the target to become a Psychic type. Fails if the target is Arceus, Silvally, or is already only a Psychic type.

751.description: The user attacks twice using Dreepy. If there are two opposing Pokémon, this move hits each of them once.
751.effect: Hits twice in one turn. In Double Battles, this move will hit both enemy targets. If it would fail to hit one of the targets, the other target will be hit twice.

752.description: The user has teatime with all the Pokémon currently in the battle. Each Pokémon eats its held Berry.
752.effect: All Pokemon on the field consume their held berries. This effect is not prevented by Substitute, Embargo, Magic Room, Klutz, or Unnerve. Fails if no active Pokemon is holding a berry.

753.description: The user locks the target in and prevents it from fleeing. This move also lowers the target’s Defense and Sp. Def every turn.
753.effect: Prevents the target from switching out. At the end of each turn, the targets Defense and Special Defense are lowered by 1 stage. The target may switch out using a Shed shell, Baton Pass, Flip turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-Turn, or Volt Switch. This effect ends if either Pokemon leave the field.

754.description: The user stabs the target with its electrified beak. If the user attacks before the target, the power of this move is doubled.
754.effect: Power doubles if the user moves before the target.

755.description: The user rends the target with its hard gills. If the user attacks before the target, the power of this move is doubled.
755.effect: Power doubles if the user moves before the target.

756.description: With its mysterious power, the user swaps the effects on either side of the field.
756.effect: Switches the Mist, Light Screen, Reflect, Spikes, Safeguard, Tailwind, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, Water Pledge, Fire Pledge, Grass Pledge, Sticky Web, Aurora Veil, G-Max Steelsurge, G-Max Cannonade, G-Max Vine Lash, and G-Max Wildfire effects from the user's side to the opposing side and vice versa.
